gloss: to rest, to take a day off

definitions.explanation: To relax or take a break.

definitions.gloss: to be absent, to take time off
definitions.explanation: To not attend school or work.

examples.japanese: {少|すこ}し{休|やす}みましょう。
{疲|つか}れたから{休|やす}みたい。
examples.english: I'm tired, so I want to rest.

examples.japanese: お{大事|だいじ}に。ゆっくり{休|やす}んでください。
{仕事|しごと}が{終|お}わったら、{家|いえ}で{休|やす}むつもりです。
examples.english: After work is finished, I plan to rest at home.

examples.japanese: {昨日|きのう}は{一日|いちにち}{中|じゅう}{歩|ある}いたので、{今日|きょう}は{足|あし}が{痛|いた}くて、{休|やす}んでいます。
examples.english: I walked all day yesterday, so my legs hurt today and I'm resting.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{学校|がっこう}を{休|やす}みます。
examples.english: I'm taking the day off from school today.

examples.japanese: {風邪|かぜ}で{会社|かいしゃ}を{休|やす}みました。
examples.english: I took the day off from work because of a cold.

examples.japanese: {来週|らいしゅう}の{金曜日|きんようび}は{休|やす}んでもいいですか？
examples.english: May I take next Friday off?

examples.japanese: {田中|たなか}さんは{三日|みっか}{前|まえ}から{休|やす}んでいます。
examples.english: Mr. Tanaka has been absent for three days.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}が{熱|ねつ}を{出|だ}したので、{今日|きょう}は{仕事|しごと}を{休|やす}んで、{家|いえ}にいなければなりません。
examples.english: My child has a fever, so I have to take the day off work and stay home today.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: Sense 1 {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive), Sense 2 {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive with を). No pair verb.

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing state. {休|やす}んでいる = 'is resting' or 'is off (work/school).'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{少|すこ}し{休|やす}む (rest a little)
・{学校|がっこう}を{休|やす}む (take day off school)
・{仕事|しごと}を{休|やす}む (take day off work)
・ゆっくり{休|やす}む (rest well)

Godan verb: te-form {休|やす}んで.

Related:
- {休|やす}み (break, vacation)
- {休日|きゅうじつ} (holiday).
